name: count-badge
title: Count Badge
description: A count on the corner of an icon that springs in, jumps as it rises, rolls its number and shrinks away at zero.

perf.budget: One small view and three shared values; it animates only when the count changes. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The number changes in place without the jump; the badge still appears and disappears.
a11y.screenReader: The badge reads its label, such as "3 unread"; it is hidden at zero.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive; the element under it keeps its own target.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { CountBadge } from '@/components/kinetik/count-badge';

<CountBadge count={unread} formatLabel={(n) => `${n} unread`}>
  <InboxIcon />
</CountBadge>;
```

## When to use

- Unread messages, new notifications, items in a cart: a count that changes while people watch.
- A presence or "something new" dot with `dot`.

## When not to use

- Static labels or categories. Use a plain tag.
- Counts so large they stop meaning anything; prefer a dot, or cap with `max`.

## Notes

- The badge springs in for the first item, jumps when the count rises, rolls the number up or down, and shrinks away at zero.
- It reads its own label (`formatLabel`) for screen readers; give the element underneath its own name too.
- `ringColor` should match what is behind the anchor so the badge looks cut out of it.
- With reduced motion the number changes in place, without the jump.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add count-badge`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
